title: Put the Speech Away  (Guarda ese discurso)

segments.t: A las tres menos cinco, detrás del mostrador de recepción, Arthur se endereza la corbata con nerviosismo mientras declama cinco páginas apretadas frente a Hannah y Graham. Escucha primero toda la escena.
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
Repasemos con una sonrisa estos últimos cinco minutos antes de la visita.
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
'"Estimado representante municipal, durante más de ochenta años este patio histórico..."'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
'Jefe, si habla como un manual de impuestos, la funcionaria se va a quedar dormida de pie.'
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
'Respire hondo una vez, Arthur, y guarde las cinco páginas en el cajón.'
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
'¿¡En el cajón!? ¿¡Entonces qué digo cuando cruce el portón!?'
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
'Diga: "¡Buenas tardes, bienvenida a la habitación nueve, siéntese por favor a tomar un té caliente!"'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
'Deje que los cristales soleados, el pan tibio de Tessa y el piano de Evelyn hablen por sí solos.'
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
'¿De verdad crees que basta con una hospitalidad sencilla?'
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
'La hospitalidad es lo que mejor ha sabido hacer esta casa durante más de ochenta años, Arthur.'
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
'Espera, ¿tengo las gafas de leer en la frente ahora mismo?'
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
'A salvo en el bolsillo de su chaqueta, jefe. Corbata recta, zapatos limpios.'
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
'¡Escuchen, acaba de sonar la campanilla del portón del patio! ¡Las tres en punto clavadas!'
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
'Respiro hondo... sonrisa... ¡vamos a dar la bienvenida a nuestra invitada!'
Volvamos a escuchar de principio a fin este momento de nervios en recepción.
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
El solemne discurso descansa en el cajón, la campanilla suena a las tres en punto y Arthur sale hacia el patio con una sonrisa sincera. Nos vemos en la próxima escena.
See you soon!
